service_name.description: Name of the AREX service instance.

log_level.description: Global log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

work_dir.description: Base working directory for Arc services.

authz.description: Authorization backend to use (e.g., xacml, simple, none).

arex.port.description: TCP port for the AREX REST API.

arex.host.description: Network interface to bind the AREX service to.

arex.use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the AREX API.

arex.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent job processing workers.

arex.worker_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for worker job execution.

arex.executor.description: Executor backend (e.g., local, slurm, lsf, pbs).

arex.job_root.description: Path where job work directories and metadata are stored.

storage.path.description: Local path for user data and job-related files.

storage.max_size.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of user storage per user.

storage.ldap_url.description: LDAP URL for user/group resolution (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com:389). Set empty to disable.

storage.ldap_basedn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., dc=example,dc=com). Required if ldap_url is set.

services.description: List of additional service instances (e.g., ARCo, ARC-REST extensions) to configure.

name.description: Unique service section name (e.g., arco, arc-rest).

port.description: TCP port to bind this service to.

host.description: Interface to bind this service to.

log_level.description: Log level override for this service.

work_dir.description: Per-service working directory override (defaults to global work_dir).
